question: A sum becomes double in 12 years at simple interest. In how many years will it become 5 times itself?
explanation:
Doubling means interest = P (one times the sum) in 12 years.
5 times itself means interest = 4P.
Simple interest grows evenly, so 4P takes 4 × 12 = 48 years.
